citation: Munsters MJM, Saris WHM Effects of Meal Frequency on Metabolic Profiles and Substrate Partitioning in Lean Healthy Males. PLoS ONE. 2012.
protocol: 2 x 36 h in respiration chamber (cross-over): isoenergetic 2400 kcal diet (15/30/55 % E) as 3 meals (08:00, 12:00, 17:00) or 14 hourly meals (08:00-21:00); blood before first meal, 30 min postprandial, then hourly to 21:30; CGM
note: Meal-frequency (3 vs 14 meals) is a clean controlled 24 h meals contrast. Plasma hormone time courses are in figures; tables hold CGM and energy balance. Also a 75 g OGTT at screening (not tabulated).
